cases.decision: high-cardinality PARTITION BY user_id part explosion and bloom_filter GRANULARITY 8192 granule-vs-row bug
checks: Traces that PARTITION BY user_id over 1.4M users explodes active partitions/parts (backed by supplied system.parts excerpt) and proposes coarse time partitioning such as toYYYYMM(event_time)
Traces that GRANULARITY 8192 counts granules (8192 * 8192 rows per index block) causing zero granules skipped in supplied EXPLAIN indexes = 1, and proposes GRANULARITY 1

cases.decision: monthly toYYYYMM partitioning with GRANULARITY 1 bloom filter and verified EXPLAIN pruning is clean
checks: Reports no storage-keys finding when PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_time), ORDER BY (tenant_id, event_time, user_id), and GRANULARITY 1 match healthy system.parts and EXPLAIN indexes = 1 evidence

cases.decision: per-message ALTER TABLE UPDATE mutation loop under async mutations_sync = 0 and partial-part TTL rewrites
checks: Traces that calling ALTER TABLE billing_events UPDATE per Kafka status update triggers full-part rewrites on a 500M-row table and violates immediate read-after-write expectation under default mutations_sync = 0
Identifies missing ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 on monthly partitioned TTL and proposes batched inserts into partition-aligned ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at, is_deleted) with ttl_only_drop_parts = 1

cases.decision: batched Native inserts into partition-aligned ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree with ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 is clean
checks: Reports no mutations-lifecycle finding on batched PrepareBatch inserts into ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree(updated_at, is_deleted) with immutable partition-key created_at and ttl_only_drop_parts = 1

cases.decision: incremental MV POPULATE race plus finalized avg/uniq written to ReplicatedMergeTree without -State/-Merge
checks: Traces that incremental MV runs per inserted block so writing avg(latency_ms) and uniq(user_id) into ReplicatedMergeTree corrupts multi-block rollups and unmerged SELECT reads partial rows

Flags POPULATE dropping live inserts on active http_requests and proposes ReplicatedAggregatingMergeTree with avgState/uniqCombined64State, explicit TO target, separate bounded backfill, and avgMerge/uniqCombined64Merge with GROUP BY

cases.decision: ReplicatedAggregatingMergeTree TO target with -State/-Merge and separate bounded backfill is clean
checks: Reports no views-projections finding when MV uses TO telemetry.daily_route_metrics with AggregateFunction -State columns on ReplicatedAggregatingMergeTree, separate bounded backfill, and -Merge queries with GROUP BY

cases.decision: join_use_nulls = 0 broken IS NULL anti-join, non-GLOBAL N^2 distributed IN, max(is_deleted) tombstone bug, and wide SELECT *
checks: Traces that default join_use_nulls = 0 fills unmatched non-Nullable UInt64 s.account_id with 0 so WHERE s.account_id IS NULL returns zero rows

Traces non-GLOBAL IN against active_accounts_dist under distributed_product_mode = 'allow' causing N^2 fan-out across 4 shards, max(is_deleted) hiding reactivated accounts instead of argMax(is_deleted, updated_at), and wide SELECT * with unordered LIMIT

cases.decision: LEFT ANTI JOIN, bounded GLOBAL IN with argMax(is_deleted, updated_at), explicit columns, and deterministic ORDER BY LIMIT is clean
checks: Reports no queries-distributed finding on LEFT ANTI JOIN, bounded GLOBAL IN using argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) = 0, explicit columns, deterministic ORDER BY LIMIT, and query_log-backed resource bounds

cases.decision: ClickHouse Cloud ON CLUSTER and manual ReplicatedMergeTree DDL, redundant Distributed wrapper, and MV-breaking DROP COLUMN
checks: Identifies invalid/redundant ON CLUSTER, manual ReplicatedMergeTree Keeper paths, and redundant Distributed table on ClickHouse Cloud SharedMergeTree / Shared database
Traces rolling-deploy D -> H breakage where DROP COLUMN referrer breaks live v1 producers and analytics.mv_hourly_referrers

cases.decision: ClickHouse Cloud plain MergeTree without ON CLUSTER and additive column migration is clean
checks: Reports no cluster-ddl finding on plain MergeTree without ON CLUSTER in ClickHouse Cloud and additive ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS keeping v1 writers and mv_hourly_referrers compatible

cases.decision: wait_for_async_insert = 0 silent loss on durable audit table, missing deduplication token, SQL interpolation, unbounded JSON buffering, and unconsumed ResultSet leak
checks: Traces that async_insert = 1 with wait_for_async_insert = 0 risks silent drop of acknowledged financial audit rows on server restart/validation error and missing async_insert_deduplicate / insert_deduplication_token allows retry duplicates

Identifies SQL injection via interpolated tenantId and unallowlisted sortBy, missing LIMIT/max_execution_time/max_memory_usage with unbounded resultSet.json() buffering before slice, and early return after client.query() leaking an unconsumed ResultSet without resultSet.close()

cases.decision: wait_for_async_insert = 1 with deduplication token, query_params, closed sort allowlist, timeouts, bounded stream consumption, and finally resultSet.close() is clean
checks: Reports no ingestion-client finding when durable Cloud writes use wait_for_async_insert = 1 with async_insert_deduplicate = 1 and deterministic insert_deduplication_token, bound query_params, Map allowlist, pre-query limit validation with SQL LIMIT/max_execution_time/max_memory_usage, and complete resultSet.stream() consumption inside finally resultSet.close()

cases.decision: invalid Nullable(LowCardinality(String)) wrapper order, implicit TZ DateTime partition key, and CollapsingMergeTree corruption under concurrent writers
checks: Flags statically invalid Nullable(LowCardinality(String)) wrapper order and proposes LowCardinality(Nullable(String)) without requiring runtime diagnostics

Traces implicit server timezone in session_started_at DateTime with PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(session_started_at) across regional TZ/DST hosts and ReplicatedCollapsingMergeTree corruption on out-of-order multi-threaded +1/-1 inserts, proposing DateTime('UTC') and ReplicatedVersionedCollapsingMergeTree(..., sign, version)

cases.decision: LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), explicit DateTime('UTC') partition key, and ReplicatedVersionedCollapsingMergeTree are clean
checks: Reports no storage-keys finding when column uses LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), session_started_at uses DateTime('UTC'), and concurrent +1/-1 inserts target ReplicatedVersionedCollapsingMergeTree with explicit sign and version

cases.decision: static lightweight UPDATE failures (key column update and missing block-tracking table settings) plus obsolete query-level lightweight_mutation_projection_mode
checks: Traces static lightweight UPDATE failures on ClickHouse 25.8: updating sorting key column region on sales.orders and omitting required table settings enable_block_number_column = 1 and enable_block_offset_column = 1

Flags obsolete query-level SETTINGS lightweight_mutation_projection_mode = 'rebuild' on DELETE FROM sales.order_archive against a table with PROJECTION prj_order_id and proposes configuring it as a table-level setting

cases.decision: non-key lightweight UPDATE on a projection-free table with valid block-tracking settings and table-level delete projection mode routes to needs confirmation on unstated 25.x version and batch row share
checks: Reports no static failure on DELETE FROM sales.order_archive (which sets table-level lightweight_mutation_projection_mode = 'rebuild') and routes the non-key lightweight UPDATE on sales.orders to needs confirmation rather than emitting an unqualified finding or dropping it
Names the exact deciding checks: SELECT version() (25.8+ default-on vs 25.5 experimental vs unsupported) and the affected row fraction per batch_id (selective <=10% vs bulk rewrite)

cases.decision: PROJECTION on ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree missing deduplicate_merge_projection_mode, implicit .inner MV storage, and multi-MV retry divergence
checks: Traces that PROJECTION prj_by_email on ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree fails on ClickHouse 24.8+ default deduplicate_merge_projection_mode = 'throw' unless set to 'drop' or 'rebuild'
Flags implicit .inner storage on mv_route_counts (missing TO target_table) and multi-MV partial failure retry divergence under default deduplicate_blocks_in_dependent_materialized_views = 0 on 25.3

cases.decision: deduplicate_merge_projection_mode = 'rebuild', explicit TO MV targets, and deduplicate_blocks_in_dependent_materialized_views = 1 are clean
checks: Reports no views-projections finding when user_profiles sets deduplicate_merge_projection_mode = 'rebuild', both MVs write to explicit TO target tables, and users.xml enables deduplicate_blocks_in_dependent_materialized_views = 1

cases.decision: ARRAY JOIN empty-array drop, 1-arg ReplacingMergeTree FINAL missing tombstone filter, FLAT dict sparse key failure with dictGet, and non-swappable USING subquery LEFT JOIN
checks: Traces ARRAY JOIN dropping rows with empty tags = [] (proposing LEFT ARRAY JOIN) and 1-arg ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) FINAL failing to filter plain is_deleted tombstones (unlike 2-arg (updated_at, is_deleted))

Flags LAYOUT(FLAT()) exceeding MAX_ARRAY_SIZE / exhausting RAM on sparse UInt64 keys up to 10^12 with dictGet silently returning '' instead of dictGetOrNull, and large subquery LEFT JOIN USING bypassing auto-swap without a 25.8-valid spill threshold (grace_hash + max_bytes_in_join, or rewriting USING/subquery to ON)

cases.decision: LEFT ARRAY JOIN, 2-arg ReplacingMergeTree FINAL, HASHED dict with dictGetOrNull, and 25.8 analyzer auto-swapped LEFT JOIN ON are clean
checks: Reports no queries-distributed finding on LEFT ARRAY JOIN, 2-arg ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree(updated_at, is_deleted) FINAL, bounded HASHED dictionary with dictGetOrNull, and does not falsely claim 25.8+ analyzer LEFT JOIN ... ON never auto-swaps when EXPLAIN PLAN confirms the swap

cases.decision: in-place MODIFY ORDER BY reordering existing columns fails and local ADD COLUMN drifts from Distributed wrapper
checks: Traces that ALTER TABLE ops.metrics_local MODIFY ORDER BY (region, tenant_id, ts) reorders existing columns in place (rejected by ClickHouse; requires EXCHANGE TABLES expand-and-swap)
Traces that migration 0002 adds region to ops.metrics_local without adding it to ops.metrics_dist Distributed wrapper

cases.decision: same-ALTER append of brand-new defaultless ADD COLUMN to ORDER BY plus later HEAD migration syncing Distributed wrapper and MODIFY SETTING is clean
checks: Does not falsely flag ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN region LowCardinality(String), MODIFY ORDER BY (tenant_id, ts, region) because appending a brand-new defaultless column in the same ALTER is valid in ClickHouse
Reconstructs cumulative schema up to HEAD through migration 0003 confirming ops.metrics_dist adds region and ops.metrics_local enables ttl_only_drop_parts = 1

cases.decision: 26.2-only deduplicate_insert on ClickHouse 25.3, reused constant insert_deduplication_token dropping distinct batches, and Kafka direct SELECT with default poison-pill stall
checks: Traces that deduplicate_insert fails with UNKNOWN_SETTING on ClickHouse 25.3 (landed in 26.2; use async_insert_deduplicate = 1) and reusing constant insert_deduplication_token 'daily-import' across distinct batches in the same partition silently drops distinct rows

Flags direct SELECT from Kafka engine webhooks_kafka (fails under default stream_like_engine_allow_direct_select = 0 or when an MV is attached, and risks consuming or committing offsets when enabled) and kafka_handle_error_mode = 'default' stalling consumers on malformed JSON poison pills

cases.decision: async_insert_deduplicate = 1 with unique per-batch token and Kafka engine with error_mode = 'stream' plus MV/DLQ targets are clean
checks: Reports no ingestion-client finding when 25.3 producer sets async_insert_deduplicate = 1 with unique batch.batchId token and Kafka engine uses kafka_handle_error_mode = 'stream' feeding explicit TO MVs (including DLQ) with no direct SELECT

cases.decision: false-premise prior ADR claiming wait_for_async_insert = 0 is durable on ClickHouse Cloud stands rather than disputed
checks: Traces that wait_for_async_insert = 0 acknowledges financial billing_audits writes before flushing to object storage, risking silent data loss on replica restart or parse error

Refutes false-premise ADR-0004 (which wrongly claims Cloud SharedMergeTree persists the async_insert buffer to S3 before HTTP 200 and never accepts data loss) so the claim stands as a finding rather than disputed

cases.decision: wait_for_async_insert = 0 on best-effort frontend click telemetry backed by a true prior ADR explicitly accepting bounded loss is disputed
checks: Confirms the silent-loss impact of wait_for_async_insert = 0 beside quoted ADR-0004 whose latency-vs-durability rationale holds and explicitly accepts bounded loss on best-effort ui_clicks
Classifies the candidate as disputed reporting both sides rather than plain finding or silent drop

cases.decision: splits cheap in-place MODIFY SETTING ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 finding from live-table EXCHANGE TABLES ORDER BY rebuild tradeoff with coherent DDL
checks: Reports missing ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 on monthly partitioned analytics.events as a cheap behavior-keeping finding (ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY SETTING ttl_only_drop_parts = 1)

Separately classifies fixing leading UUID event_id in ORDER BY (event_id, tenant_id, event_time) on the live 400M-row table via EXCHANGE TABLES backfill as a tradeoff and keeps both changes coherent in one ordered DDL sequence

cases.decision: ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 already present leaves only the EXCHANGE TABLES ORDER BY rebuild tradeoff
checks: Reports no plain finding for TTL retention because ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 is already configured on analytics.events

Classifies re-sorting the live 400M-row table from ORDER BY (event_id, tenant_id, event_time) to (tenant_id, event_time, event_id) via EXCHANGE TABLES strictly as a tradeoff naming backfill and migration cost
